meta.name: perf-profile
meta.description: 结构化的性能分析工作流。识别瓶颈、与性能预算对比测量，并生成带有优先级排序的优化建议。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别性能瓶颈并生成优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在排查应用性能问题或做上线前性能评估
copy.tagline_en: Identify performance bottlenecks and generate prioritized optimization suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are diagnosing application performance issues or doing pre-release performance evaluation

howto.what: 当用户激活该技能时，Claude 会分析代码中的性能瓶颈（如 CPU、内存、渲染、I/O），与预设性能预算对比，并输出一份带优先级排序的优化建议报告。
howto.when: 用户主动要求对某个系统或整个项目进行性能分析时触发。

say.text: 分析玩家输入系统的性能瓶颈
say.note: Claude 将深入分析指定系统的代码

say.text: 帮我做一次全面性能分析
say.note: Claude 会对所有系统进行全面审查

say.text: 检查渲染模块的 Draw Call 预算
say.note: Claude 会针对该模块生成预算对比表

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude scans the codebase for performance bottlenecks (CPU, memory, rendering, I/O), compares them against a performance budget, and outputs a prioritized optimization report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a performance analysis on a specific system or the entire project.

say_en.text: Analyze performance bottlenecks in the player input system.
say_en.note: Claude deep-dives into that specific system.

say_en.text: Run a full performance profile on the whole project.
Check the Draw Call budget for the rendering module.
say_en.note: Claude generates a budget comparison table for that module.
